_comment: Charities the HumanityOS maintainer personally endorses, shown in the 'Charities I support' section of the donate page (both clients hide the section while this list is empty). These are INDEPENDENT nonprofits, unaffiliated with HumanityOS; a gift goes to that organization directly (not to HumanityOS or its maintainer). Sponsor-a-Can was listed here until 2026-10-04 and is now one of the two giving routes at the top of the page (data/donate/routes.json), so it is not repeated here. Add an entry to feature a charity (infinite-of-X). Read by both the web donate page and native donate.rs. Fields: name, mission, url (their donate page), note (deductibility / relationship disclosure), abbrev, color.
